scenarios.behavior: A prompt gets the scripted answer, and the turn ends as answered.
Cancelling while the model is still answering ends the turn as cancelled.
A rejected file write leaves the file absent and tells the model, and the turn still ends as answered.

exempt.kap.file_upload: KAP uploads attachments to /files before the prompt, while ACP clients embed them in the prompt, so there is no shared step to compare.
exempt.kap.fs_query: Workspace browsing for the desktop and web clients; ACP clients read the workspace themselves.
exempt.kap.mcp: Not compared yet: KAP hosts configure MCP servers, while ACP clients pass them with each session.
exempt.kap.tasks: Background task controls exist only in KAP.
exempt.kap.agent_close: Side-channel (btw) agents exist only in KAP; ACP sessions have none to close.
exempt.acp.loadSession: Not compared yet: KAP returns turn pages, while ACP replays session updates.
exempt.acp.promptCapabilities.image: Not compared yet: KAP sends images as uploaded files.
exempt.acp.promptCapabilities.embeddedContext: Embedded resources are an ACP prompt format with no KAP counterpart.
exempt.acp.mcpCapabilities.http: Not compared yet: ACP clients pass MCP servers with each session, while KAP hosts configure them.
exempt.acp.mcpCapabilities.sse: Not compared yet: ACP clients pass MCP servers with each session, while KAP hosts configure them.
exempt.acp.auth.logout: ACP clients sign out through the agent, KAP hosts through their OAuth routes.
